info.name: KCG CRM - Lead Flow
info.description:
Lead -> round robin -> call -> follow-up / not interested / not eligible -> interested -> profile -> document email -> student portal upload -> review -> profile approval -> interview -> selected -> INR 11,800 payment (online / offline) -> pre-placement offer + provisional admission letters.

Run the folders in order on a fresh database. Variables: base_url, email / password (a Super Admin), counsellor_password, student_password, follow_up_date / interview_date / today (YYYY-MM-DD, future dates).
Requests that act as the counsellor / student / finance user carry their own bearer token stored by the login requests in 02 Setup and 05 Profile. File uploads use the formdata field 'file' — pick any PDF / image.

Every response has the shape {success, message, status, data} (+ pagination on lists).
